2. The respondent No. 1 as plaintiff filed the suit for declaration of title to the suit land measuring 1.03 acres of land in plot Nos. 1883, 1884, 1887 and 1890 of CS Khatian Nos. 31, 33 and 144 under Mouza Maheswarpasha in the District of Khulna. 

 5. At the trial, the plaintiff has examined 3 witnessed, PW 1 is Sheikh Shamsur Rahman who is the plaintiff himself, PW 2 Momin Box is contiguous land holder, PW 3, Noni Gopal Munshi is one of the executants of the sale deed. The plaintiff also filed certified copy of the Kabala deed dated 29-6-1965 executed by Nitya Nanda Munshi in favour of Ahmed Reza which is marked Exhibit-3, certified copy of the kabala deed executed by Nani Gopal Munshi in favour of Reza which is marked Exhibit- 3(a), the copies of the dakhilas marked Exhibit 19(a) to 19( c) series and also filed the certified copies of the khatians which are marked exhibits 2(a) to 2(c) of his contention. 

 25. The plaintiff in order to prove his case has filed certain papers Exhibits 1, 2 and 3 series and examined as many as 3 witnessed on his side including himself as PW 1. The papers Exhibits-1 to 1 (e) are the dakhilas granted by the government tahsilder in respect of the suit land. From those dakhilas, it appears that defendant Nos. 3 and 4 before their sale of suit land by virtue of the sale deeds Exhibits 3 and 4 paid rent to the government in respect of the suit land. Thus it appears that the rent receipts filed by the plaintiff were definitely lying with the original owners namely, defendant Nos. 3 and 4, who handed over the same to the plaintiff at the time of the impugned sale. The papers under Exhibits 2 to 2(c) are the CS and SA khatians in respect of the suit land. These Khatians are also handed over to the plaintiff by the vendors namely, defendant Nos. 3 and 4, at the time of their sale of the suit land by the sale deeds Exhibit 3 and 3(a). The plaintiff while deposing as PW 1 has made statements in unambiguous terms that he purchased the suit land from defendant Nos. 3 and 4 by the sale deeds in the benami of defendant No. 1 who happened to be his close friend. He further deposed that the motive of his benami purchase was due to fear of the creditors. The PW 1 has further asserted that it is he who paid the entire consideration money of the transaction and it is he who has been possessing the suit land in his own right. Such statement of PW I on the point of benami purchase of the suit land and possession over the same had been corroborated by PWs 2 and 3 almost in the same agreements. PW 2 Momin Box has made statements that the plaintiff has been possessing the suit land for 12/13 years and that defendant No. 2 or anybody else never possessed the same. We do not find any reasons to disbelieve the evidence of PW 2. The PW 3 is Noni Gopal Munshi who is defendant No. 4 in the suit. He is also the executant of the kabala Exhibit 3(a). Thus PW 3 has made a categorical statement that the suit land belonged to him and his brother. They sold out the land to the plaintiff who paid them entire consideration money. He further deposed that he sold out his share on receipt of Taka 5,000 from the plaintiff who got the deed in the benami of defendant No. 1 Ahmed Reza who was his close friend; that his brother also sold out his share to the plaintiff for Taka 4925 by a different kabala and that the plaintiff got such kabala in the benami of defendant No.1.
